claude.text:
*takes a few seconds, scrolling up and down with my thumb*

Okay so... first look, this is Astro trying to get me to subscribe to one of their TV packs lah. Three options — Entertainment, Sports, Epic. Classic tiered pricing. I've seen this layout before, very standard.

My eyes go straight to the Sports pack because — obviously, football. RM69.99 a month, and it says "was RM89.99" so they're doing that crossed-out price thing to make it feel like a deal. I notice it says Sooka Sports is included, which... okay, I already use Sooka for free? So that's a bit confusing to me already. Like, am I paying for something I currently get without paying?

The Epic one — wah, RM159.99? And the original price was *lower* at RM139.99? So the price went *up*? That's already a red flag for me. Who approved that copy, man.

For best value... honestly if I had to pick, I'd say Sports at RM69.99 looks the most relevant to me personally. But here's the thing — I'm not actually sure what I'm getting for that price beyond "Sooka Sports + Sports Extra." Like, does that mean live matches? Which leagues? EPL? Is there a box involved or is this purely streaming? The page doesn't tell me that clearly just from looking at it.

I'd *expect* it to include live sport streaming, maybe some on-demand stuff, and based on the "2 devices" thing, I can share it maybe with one of my housemates. But honestly? I'm not confident. I'm guessing.

And that 12-month contract part — that's already making me hesitate sikit. I don't commit to things 12 months in advance lah. That's not really how I operate.

openai.text:
Okay, so looking at this page, it's offering three different Astro TV plans. From what I can see, it's all about streaming and there's a focus on either entertainment, sports, or an all-in type of experience. 

For me, the sports plan stands out because it mentions Sooka Sports and Sports Extra. Since I already use Sooka for football, this seems relevant. The price is RM69.99, down from RM89.99, but it's still on a 12-month contract. Not quite sure about this contract thing lah, feels like a commitment and I'm not sure if a set-top box is needed or not.

Looking at the value, I'd probably consider the sports plan because of the Sooka inclusion, but the price is a bit steep. I'd expect this price to cover more than just sports, maybe some local content too, but it's not clear from just the plan name. The "Want more value?" section with Netflix and Disney+ suggests that those are add-ons and not included in the base price.

If I'm just looking for football and maybe some local shows, RM69.99 might be okay, but I'd need to know more about what's actually included in the Sports plan before I decide to commit. And honestly, I'd prefer if they offered monthly payments through e-wallets instead of this contract thingy.
